Column: bench.customers.tags
Type: ARRAY<TEXT> (list: contains(tags, x), contains_any / contains_all(tags, [...]), length(tags); its elements are tags.value)
Sample values: ["vip", "eu", "newsletter", "partner", "trial", "nordic", "alpine", "wholesale"]

SQL:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "customers._count"
FROM customers AS customers
WHERE
  CASE
    WHEN customers.tags IS NULL OR ['vip', 'eu'] IS NULL
    THEN NULL
    ELSE LIST_HAS_ALL(
      [__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN customers.tags IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL],
      [__slayer_e FOR __slayer_e IN ['vip', 'eu'] IF __slayer_e IS NOT NULL]
    )
  END
LIMIT 21
